website_summary.name: Team Project Showcase Hub
website_summary.description: The website presents a clean and professional interface showcasing team projects, skills, and contact details with a dark cyan and whitesmoke color scheme.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a structured layout with distinct sections. It starts with a header containing the title "Team Project Showcase" and a toggle button for theme switching. Below the header, there's an "About Us" section divided into three parts: "Our Story," "Our Mission," and "Our Values," each with concise descriptions. Following this is the "Featured Projects" section displaying three project cards with images, titles, descriptions, and technology tags. The "Our Expertise" section highlights four key areas—Web Development, UI/UX Design, Mobile Development, and Cloud Services—with corresponding icons. Finally, the "Get in Touch" section includes contact information and a form for user interaction. The footer contains copyright information. The overall design uses a dark cyan accent color against a whitesmoke background.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to browse team information, view project cases, understand team skills, and contact the team. Users can explore featured projects by clicking on project cards, which likely lead to more detailed pages. The expertise section visually represents the team's capabilities. The contact form enables users to send messages directly to the team. Additionally, the header provides a theme toggle for user preference adjustments.
